data.gender_notes: Prudy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the English word ‘prudent’, meaning wise, sensible, and discerning. However, the name Prudy has come to be associated with modesty, virtue, and simplicity. In the Middle Ages, prudence was considered one of the seven heavenly virtues. The name Prudy carries the meaning “Pure, Precious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Prudy usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prudy total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
